intro: Every night should end in comfort, and Vurv makes sure of it. With high-quality PU foam and a soft quilted finish on both sides, it’s designed to give you the perfect balance of support and relaxation.

features.title: Support that stays with you
features.text: Crafted with premium PU foam, the Vurv mattress offers exceptional support and durability, resisting daily wear and tear for a lasting sleep solution.

features.title: Flip it, love it
features.text: Enjoy versatile luxury with PU foam quilting on both sides, providing an extra cushioning layer and dual usability for enhanced value.

features.title: Wrapped in elegance
features.text: Wrapped in an attractive maroon and gold polyester fabric, the mattress adds a touch of sophistication while ensuring a soft, cosy sleep surface.

features.title: Built to last, night after night
features.text: Engineered for everyday use, this mattress withstands time with superior materials and construction, promising unwavering comfort night after night.

features.title: Fits your bed perfectly
features.text: Available in a variety of dimensions, it’s a perfect fit for flat wooden bedsteads, making it versatile for any setup.

name: Vurv Queen Bed Foam Mattress 72 X 60 X 5 Inches
